site.name: GFTV HelloEvents
meta.description: Find furmeets and furry conventions, and RSVP. By Global Furry Television.
language.modal.title: Choose a language
official.line: An official Global Furry Television website
official.domain-heading: Official GFTV sites end with globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from the end, at the last dot before the first single slash. A site ending in anything else is not GFTV, even if the name appears earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full list of official GFTV sites
official.secure-body: Look for a padlock, or https:// at the start of the address. Only share personal details on an official site over a secure connection.
update.label: Update
update.ready: A new version of GFTV HelloEvents is ready.
theme.title: Theme
theme.time-note: Light from {from} to {until} on this device's clock, dark otherwise. Now: {mode}.
home.meta-title: GFTV HelloEvents | Furmeets and furry conventions
home.title: Furmeets and furry conventions
home.lede: Find your next meet, see how many are going, and RSVP with your GFTV account.
home.empty: Nothing here yet. Check back soon.
event.missing-lede: It may have moved, or it is not public yet.
event.preview: Preview: this event is not public yet. Only editors can see it.
event.online-for-attendees: The online link is shown to people going.
event.address-for-attendees: The street address is shown to people going.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.lede: That address does not lead anywhere on this site.
login.title: Sign in
login.lede: Use your HelloEvents account, or your GFTV staff account.
login.factor-lede: Confirm it is you with one of these.
login.help-totp: Open your authenticator app and type the six digit code for GFTV.
login.help-passkey: Use the passkey you made for this site. Your device will ask you to confirm.
login.help-telegram: Press Send me a code, then type the code the HelloEvents bot sends you.
login.help-backup: Type one of your backup codes. Each one works once.
setup.totp-help: Scan this with Google Authenticator or any authenticator app, then type the six digit code it shows.
setup.totp-manual: Or type this key into the app:
setup.totp-qr-label: QR code for your authenticator app
codes.file-heading: Backup codes for {site}. Each one works once.
account.signed-out-others: Every other session on this site is signed out.
security.title: Security
security.totp-shared: Set up on your GFTV account at gftv.asia. Change it there.
security.telegram-pending: Press Start in Telegram, then come back to this page.
security.backup-left.one: {count} unused backup code from this site.
security.backup-left.other: {count} unused backup codes from this site.
security.password-lede: For your safety, type your password again.
manage.title: Manage events
manage.lede: Drafts and events with a release time in the future are seen by editors only.
manage.delete-lede: The event and its RSVP list are removed for good. To keep the record, set it to Cancelled instead.
manage.field.title: Title
manage.field.datesHidden: Dates to be announced: keep the dates off the public page
manage.field.addressAttendeesOnly: Show the street address only to people going
manage.field.priceHidden: Hide the price: show "to be announced" publicly
manage.hint.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Blank makes one from the title.
manage.hint.description: Plain text. Line breaks are kept.
manage.hint.timezone: Where the event happens, for example Asia/Singapore. Times below are in this zone.
manage.hint.publishLocal: A published event stays hidden until this time, in the event time zone.
manage.hint.staffNotes: Editors only. Never shown on the public page.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.bad_request: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.bad_origin: That request came from somewhere else and was refused.
error.bad_content_type: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.method_not_allowed: That request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in and try again.
error.invalid_credentials: That username or password is not right.
error.no_access: This account is not approved for GFTV sites yet.
error.challenge_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
error.no_passkeys: This account has no passkey for this site.
error.passkey_expired: That took too long. Try the passkey again.
error.passkey_failed: The passkey did not work. Try again, or use another way.
error.passkey_exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.
error.telegram_off: Telegram is not available on this site.
error.telegram_not_linked: No Telegram chat is linked to this account.
error.human_check_failed: The are-you-a-person check did not pass. Try again.
error.human_check_pending: Wait for the are-you-a-person check to finish.
error.human_check_unavailable: The are-you-a-person check is not working on our side right now, so this cannot go through. Try again later.
error.last_factor: This is your only second step. Add another one before removing it.
error.not_found: That event is not here any more.
error.rsvp_closed: RSVPs for this event are closed.
error.slug_taken: Another event already uses that address.
error.manage_only: Only GFTV editors and admins can manage events.
error.admin_only: Only GFTV admins can do this.
error.copy: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
login.staff-note: GFTV staff: set up your authenticator app and reset your password on gftv.asia.
signup.title: Create an account
signup.lede: An account lets you RSVP to events and get notified about them.
signup.username-hint: 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
signup.display-hint: Shown to event organisers when you RSVP.
signup.email-hint: For signing in. Never shown to anyone.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lede: No email is sent. Reset with a code from your linked Telegram, with one of your backup codes, or with a reset code from GFTV staff.
reset.staff: This is a GFTV staff account. Reset its password on gftv.asia.
reset.code-lede: Pick how to prove it is you.
reset.factor-help: Your account has a second step, so it is needed too.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.lede: Only about events. Nothing else is ever sent.
notify.updates: When an event I am going to changes time or place, or is cancelled
notify.reminders: A reminder the day before an event I am going to
notify.new-events: When a new event is announced
notify.push-unavailable: Browser notifications are not set up on this site yet.
notify.push-unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from websites. On an iPhone, add the site to your home screen first.
notify.push-on-here: Notifications are on for this device.
notify.push-off-here: Notifications are off for this device.
notify.telegram: Also send these to my linked Telegram chat
security.lede-staff: Ways to get past the second step when you sign in here. Your password is managed on gftv.asia.
security.lede-public: A second step is optional for your account, but it keeps it safe if your password leaks.
account.delete-lede: Removes your account, your RSVPs and your notification settings for good.
account.delete-confirm: This cannot be undone. Type your password to delete your account.
manage.hint.cover: A wide picture works best. Your browser turns it into a small WebP before it is uploaded.
manage.hint.cover-save-first: Save the event first, then add a picture.
error.staff_needs_2fa: Set up an authenticator app on your GFTV account at gftv.asia first.
error.username_invalid: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
error.username_reserved: That username uses a word kept for GFTV staff. Pick another.
error.email_invalid: That email address does not look right.
error.email_taken: An account with that email already exists. Try signing in.
error.display_name_invalid: Type a display name of up to 60 characters.
error.password_long: That password is too long. Use at most 72 bytes (about 72 letters).
error.password_weak: Pick a password that is harder to guess.
error.terms_required: Agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy to continue.
error.totp_exists: An authenticator app is already set up.
error.staff_account: Staff accounts are managed on gftv.asia.
error.cover_invalid: That picture could not be read. Try another one.
error.cover_not_webp: The picture must be a WebP. Try again in Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
error.cover_browser_no_webp: This browser cannot make WebP pictures. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox to upload a cover.
error.cover_too_large: That picture is too large even after compressing. Try a smaller one.
error.cover_too_big: That picture is too big. Use one at most 2400 pixels on each side.
error.cover_too_small: That picture is too small. Use one at least 320 by 180 pixels.
error.push_off: Browser notifications are not set up on this site yet.
error.push_invalid: This browser gave an unusable notification address.
error.push_service_unknown: This browser's notification service is not supported.
error.push_too_many: Notifications are on for too many devices. Turn some off first.
error.push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
error.push_unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from websites.
error.push_no_worker: The page is still starting up. Try again in a moment.
reset.not-found: No HelloEvents account has that username or email.
reset.ask-staff: This account has no linked Telegram and no 2FA, so ask GFTV staff for a reset code. They will check it is you first.
reset.done-lede: Sign in with your new password and your second step.
error.display_name_reserved: That display name uses a word kept for GFTV staff. Pick another.
error.account_not_found: No member account has that username.
admin.allowance-lede: New accounts are limited to 5 an hour from one connection. At a meet or con where everyone shares the venue's Wi-Fi, open this page on that Wi-Fi and raise the limit for that connection for a few hours. It ends by itself.
admin.allowance-grant: Raise the limit on this connection
admin.allowance-here-on: The connection you are on has a raised sign-up limit.
admin.allowance-here-off: The connection you are on has the normal sign-up limit.
admin.filter-lede: Words public accounts may not use in a username or display name. Matching ignores case, spacing, accents, look-alike letters and numbers used as letters.
admin.flagged-lede: Names chosen before a word was listed are kept, and shown here.
admin.reset-lede: For a member with no linked Telegram and no 2FA. Check it is really them first. The code is shown once, works once, and lasts 24 hours; they type it at events.globalfurry.tv/reset.
admin.reset-expires: Shown only now. Works once, until {until}.
